name: Vehicle finance comparison
audience: Buyers comparing two finance offers before they sign.
summary: Compare two vehicle offers using price, deposit, rate, and term.
description: Each offer becomes a monthly repayment estimate with the PMT formula. The workbook also shows the repayments over the full term and the extra you would pay above the amount financed. Balloon payments are not included.
benefits: Put both offers on the same page
See a monthly estimate from the rate and term
See the total repayments, not only the monthly figure
compatibility: Microsoft Excel for Microsoft 365 or Excel 2021 and later
Formulas also open in Google Sheets; confirm PMT, FV, and NPER after import
PDF guide opens in any PDF reader
DOCX guide opens in Microsoft Word or Google Docs
disclaimer: This workbook organises figures you type in. It is not financial, credit, insurance, or tax advice. Rates, fees, and laws change. A qualified adviser should review decisions that affect debt, tax, medical cover, or retirement.
